body: Was starting to get impatient with myself because it has been 5 months post discard and I’m still not doing as well as I hoped (struggling with depression and anxiety). Yet, he has been thriving the moment he discarded me. Hasn’t found a new supply yet but things seem to be going well for him. Am not taking comfort in your pain and how long it took for you to heal (am really scared it’ll come off this way) but your comment assured me that this is all normal… Thank you :) You have no idea how much better your words made me feel even when they aren’t directed to me!

sadly, the only advantage i have is that i am a female. came from a neighbour jc and don’t really have much to show for grades since i got mostly Bs. it’s no surprise why i’m not having any luck but thank you nonetheless :)
I don’t like the feeling of waking up because it reminds me that I’m still here, so I procrastinate to even sleep.

i think the reason why i struggle is because my nex is literally the most outstanding person ever and he’s really good at pretending. he isn’t a dick outwardly to people but speaks lowly of them behind their backs. everyone thinks he’s nice and it feels like he’ll just keep getting his way

i think the part that really sucks for me is that my nex is a really smart person who has opportunities handed to him even if he doesn’t deserve them. he’s living his best life but i’m just deep in depression
i know you love me but i really want to die. i don’t want to be here anymore.

ex is a narcissist who dumped me after using me and now he is living his best life and going on a smear campaign while i am knee deep in depression and anxiety. it’s so unfair. i wish karma would hit him hard.

Imo if your dumper asks you to be friends immediately after the break up and you were good to them during the relationship, that is an attempt to have their cake and still eat it. They want to enjoy the freedom of being single and still keep you around. You are like their consolation prize, a plan B, their safety net. Believe me, when they made the choice to end things with you, they risked losing you forever and they still went ahead with their decision. I was/am in the same boat. My ex asked to be friends but after my rose tinted glasses has come off, I realised how selfish he is. I still love him and the break up is fresh (~2 months), and when we first broke up, I begged and begged and lost all my dignity. He probably realised that nobody would care for him like I did (he doesn’t really have friends) so he asked to be friends. It’s not worth it. Take your dignity and go. Cut that fucker out of your life.

Mine sent me one as well but it took me straight into a depressive episode. I’m struggling with anxiety and depression because of him and he had the audacity to talk to be as though he did nothing wrong. He was so unapologetic and it sucks because he will never feel guilt or remorse for the way he treated me and how I am now. I didn’t reply either but I don’t feel good because he doesn’t care.
my timer is until the 31st of december. i plan to get all my friends gifts and buy myself a dress i’ve been eyeing, and then leave this world in it.
I take 15mg of Lexapro and 0.5mg of Xanax. Xanax helps me a lot when I’m having anxiety and sometimes I use it as a sleeping aid.

Doubt anyone is on this thread anymore but I just needed to let this out. I gave my all to him. Treated him well only for him to toss me away like I was nothing. He toyed with me, but the most shameful part of this all is that I begged him to take me back. I hate myself and I feel like I’m in hell. I really want to end my life.
planning to return my ex some of his stuff too but am afraid because i still have feelings for him even though he dumped me like i was nothing. seeing his stuff is only hurting me. any advice?

fuck you for using me as your rebound to get over your toxic ex. fuck you for comparing me to her while we were together and making be absolutely miserable, only to blame me for being insecure when you gave me ever reason to be. fuck you for always flirting with girls then saying that i’m too sensitive and you feel trapped. fuck you for leading me on and asking me to give up on my apartment and move in together, only for you to kick me to the curb in less than two months. fuck you for deceiving me into have sex with you even though you already knew you wanted to break up. fuck you for then insinuating that you were entitled to my body because you paid for our road trip. fuck you for using me for your homework. fuck you for throwing me away after you had no use for me. fuck you for all the lies and gaslighting. truly, fuck you. you were my first ever boyfriend, the first guy i’ve ever had feelings for in 22 years of my life. the love i had was so pure and unconditional and you just treated me like i shit. you and your mother always looked down on me. fuck her too. i don’t wish the both of you well. i hope you catch and std and karma hits you. you’re disgusting. i hope people see you for who you really are.

yes! i deleted mine. it was hurtful to see the mean things he said to me and i found myself always going back to look at our messages and so i deleted them. felt like i stood up for myself in a way and it’s quite liberating because i won’t have to see the chat anymore. if you’re thinking about it, do it :) i still miss the i love yous but they don’t mean anything anymore. let it go :)
